summary: Requested a clean-copy re-execution of the retained phantom-configuration experiment (b5bd70f5750b4b45af3e925bd1748aaf-experiment). The other four accounts already have multi-receipt support at their decisive boundaries, so this repeat is the action most likely to change a judgment.
